description: Open Traffic Models provides a hybrid traffic simulation framework combining native CTM, 2Q and Newell models with user plugins. The provider is OTM developers. Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository documents a Python interface to the Java simulation engine through py4j. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
